utility.notes: APS is Arizona's largest electric utility, serving most of the Phoenix metro area (though parts of Phoenix and neighboring cities are served by the Salt River Project (SRP), a separate public power district — this record is scoped to APS territory only, not assumed for all of Phoenix).

value.name: Arizona Public Service (APS)
value.notes: No Community Choice Aggregator was found serving Arizona this session (Arizona does not have a CCA framework comparable to California's). APS's own page describes its 'Resource Comparison Proxy (RCP) Export Rider' — a net billing structure that credits excess solar generation at a monthly RCP purchase rate (rolled over month to month, with an annual refund check if the credit exceeds $25), rather than traditional one-to-one net metering.

permit_authority.value: City of Phoenix Planning & Development Department (PDD)

battery_programs.notes: The City's own SolarAPP+ eligibility rules explicitly exclude battery/energy storage systems from the streamlined SolarAPP+ pathway ('No battery storage'), and no separate APS battery-specific program was independently confirmed this session.

value.name: SolarAPP+ approval document and approvals upload document (includes manufacturer specification sheets)

required_documents.notes: Per the City's own 'SolarAPP/Photovoltaic Projects' page. These documents are emailed to pdd.records@phoenix.gov with the PDD permit number and property address in the subject line; the SolarAPP+ approved checklist, three-line diagram, and plot plan must all correlate or inspection delays occur. The Phoenix Fire Department separately requires its own permit for PV and battery energy storage systems.

value: Schedule inspection online by entering the permit number and web inspection key
Call 602-262-7811 if additional assistance is required

other_conditions: Single-family or duplex residence, rooftop installations only
No battery storage; no ballasted or ground-mounted systems
Not located within a Historic Preservation district or FEMA Special Flood Hazard Area
No existing PV or energy storage systems; no panel upgrades or derating
PV system roof loading not to exceed 4 psf dead load
400-amp maximum electrical service, single phase only
Maximum of 2 DC strings in parallel; only one module type; up to two inverter types for string inverters or one inverter type for microinverters (one module per microinverter)
